title: DNA NN Simulator v2.1: GLOBECOM 2026 camera-ready data and sensitivity studies
description: Corrected simulator, configurations, regression tests, trial-level Monte Carlo data, calibration samples, summaries, and validation reports supporting the camera-ready version of '6G Network Empowering AI Agents'. The release adds high-confidence primary sweeps, a 54-configuration EIR robustness grid, physical-parameter sensitivities, and fixed-length and constant-density scaling studies.
